median_age_note: Interpolated within the five-year age group that holds the middle person, from the Pacific Community's tabulation of the 2020 census by island, five-year age group and sex (UNFPA and OCHA's COD-PS for Kiribati), which counts 7,380 people here against the census's final 7,369. The Statistics Office prints island ages and sexes only as pictures of its tables.
sex_ratio_note: Males per 100 females, from the Pacific Community's tabulation of the 2020 census by island, five-year age group and sex (UNFPA and OCHA's COD-PS for Kiribati), which counts 7,380 people here against the census's final 7,369. The Statistics Office prints island ages and sexes only as pictures of its tables.

median_age.note: Kanton's 41 people are not in the Pacific Community's tabulation of the 2020 census by age and sex, and the Statistics Office prints island ages and sexes only as pictures of its tables.
